hikes.name: Mount Walker
hikes.blurb: A steady climb through rhododendrons to two viewpoints, one over the Olympics and one across Puget Sound to Rainier.

hikes.name: Fort Worden and Point Wilson
hikes.blurb: Past old coastal gun batteries on a bluff to a lighthouse where the Strait meets Puget Sound.

hikes.name: Green Mountain
hikes.blurb: Kitsap's best viewpoint, over the Sound to Seattle, Rainier and Baker.
